metadata.description: Portable agentic dev OS: ticket lifecycle skills + team knowledge wiki. Config-driven, domain-agnostic.

plugins.name: agentic-dev-os
plugins.description: Install the full 20-skill set: the ticket lifecycle (ticket-impact, cross-repo review/test, pr-ticket-review, ticket-testing, seed-test-data, goal, wrap), wiki ops (wiki-ingest, wiki-lint), meta (skill-workshop, mcp-impact), the execution loop (operating-flow + task-intake, subagent-execute, verify-done, session-capture), and the OS lifecycle (os-init, os-doctor, os-remove).
